t: Shanghai began as a fishing village and a market town on the Huangpu River, rose with the cotton trade and the Qing customs office, and became one of five treaty ports after the First Opium War ended in 1842.

From 1843 foreign concessions grew beside the walled Chinese city, and in the 1920s and 1930s the city was a commercial and financial hub of the Asia-Pacific region, the birthplace of Chinese cinema and the place where the Chinese Communist Party was founded.
Japan invaded in 1932 and took the Chinese-held districts in 1937, the People's Liberation Army took the city in 1949, and economic reform from 1990 brought the development of Pudong.
dyk: The first Western atelier in Shanghai was established in 1864 inside the Tushanwan orphanage, and the city produced China's first fictional feature film, An Orphan Rescues His Grandfather, in 1923.
ev: Qinglong Town is established and becomes a major trading port
Shanghai becomes a county under Songjiang Prefecture
A city wall is built to protect the town from Japanese pirates
The Treaty of Nanking opens Shanghai as one of five treaty ports
The Chinese Communist Party is founded in the French Concession
The Battle of Shanghai ends in Japanese occupation of the Chinese-held districts
The People's Liberation Army takes control of the city
Deng Xiaoping permits economic reforms and Pudong is developed

f.founded: The earliest Neolithic settlements known in the area belong to the Majiabang culture (5000 to 3300 BCE); Shanghai was made a market town in 1074 and the seat of a county in the early 1290s.
f.where: On the southern estuary of the Yangtze River on China's east coast, on a flat alluvial plain bisected by the Huangpu River, bordering Zhejiang to the south and Jiangsu to the west and north.
f.known: Qinglong Town and the cotton trade; the treaty port opened in 1842; the International Settlement and French Concession; the Bund; the founding of the Chinese Communist Party in 1921; the Battle of Shanghai in 1937; Pudong and Lujiazui
f.today: Shanghai is a provincial-level municipality of China, divided into 16 districts, and the country's most populous city.
